poster.headline: TAFITI99 RESEARCH PORTFOLIO
poster.subheadline: Biostatistics, Epidemiological Pipelines & Reproducible Health Data Science in R & Quarto
poster.intro: Welcome to the TAFITI99 Research Portfolio. An open-source showcase of empirical public health research, advanced biostatistical modeling (Modified Poisson, Zou 2004), master metadata governance, and automated Quarto publication reporting.
poster.author_role: MD Candidate @ MUHAS | Biostatistical Data Analyst | Founder @ Tafiti99

items.title: R & TIDYVERSE ECOSYSTEM
items.text: Expertise in dplyr, tidyr, purrr, readr, stringr, and ggplot2 for reliable data wrangling, data validation, and publication-ready biomedical graphics.
